A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''warlord''' was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and actively hunted Republic [[Scout/Legends|scout]] ships that entered his territory. However, the Republic reached out to the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and convinced him to sign a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] contract to go after Imperial convoys instead.<ref name="TOR" />
